summary.text: Jack Richardson is the Democratic candidate for the Massachusetts House of Representatives 3rd Barnstable District in the November 3, 2026 general election against incumbent Republican David Vieira.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a third-generation, lifelong Falmouth resident who has served on the Falmouth Select Board.

paragraphs.text: Jack Richardson said in a Ballotpedia survey that his family ran the Elm Arch Inn in downtown Falmouth for almost a century, and that he attended Falmouth Public Schools and then American University in Washington, D.C.
According to the survey, he worked full-time on Capitol Hill during his junior and senior years.

Richardson said in the survey that he has served on the Falmouth Select Board and the Falmouth Housing Authority and is a town meeting member for Precinct 9, and that he was the youngest person elected to the Select Board in the town's history.

He listed among the board's actions a 10 percent residential tax exemption, a ban on Immigration and Customs Enforcement presence on town property without a judicial warrant, and permanent conservation of the Long Pond watershed.

Richardson's stated campaign priorities include lowering housing costs for year-round Cape Cod residents, municipally owned utilities, Medicare for All in Massachusetts, and investment in green energy.
He won the September 1, 2026 Democratic primary, according to Ballotpedia.
